evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Implements BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules to resolve known vulnerabilities including legacy sigop CPU exhaustion, CVE-2017-12842 Merkle tree collisions, and timewarp difficulty manipulation. While activation is restricted to regtest, soft fork validation logic demands rigorous review to ensure correctness before potential future network deployment.
